description: The end-of-bed bench length for a bed size (4 to 8 inches of bed showing at each end), its height from the mattress top, the usual depth, and whether the space at the foot of the bed leaves a walkway. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

room.description: Open floor from the foot of the bed to the wall or nearest furniture, in inches. Optional: leave out to skip the walkway check.

top.description: Floor to the top of the mattress in inches. Optional.

name: bench_size
title: End of bed bench size calculator
